mapper.insert: INSERT INTO forge_import_backup (id,task_id,record_id,field_values,expires_at,created_by,updated_by) VALUES (#{id},#{taskId},#{recordId},CAST(#{values} AS jsonb),#{expiresAt},NULL,NULL) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,task_id,record_id) WHERE NOT deleted DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_import_backup SET superseded_by_task_id=#{taskId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted AND record_id=#{recordId} AND task_id <> #{taskId} AND imported_version IS NOT NULL AND task_id IN ( SELECT id FROM forge_io_task WHERE NOT deleted AND import_model=(SELECT import_model FROM forge_io_task WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{taskId}) )
mapper.select: SELECT imported_version,expires_at,superseded_by_task_id,rollback_status FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId} AND record_id=#{recordId}
SELECT imported_version,expires_at,superseded_by_task_id,rollback_status FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId} AND record_id=#{recordId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_io_task SET snapshot_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId}), snapshot_expires_at=(SELECT MIN(expires_at) FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId}),updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM forge_io_task WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{taskId} AND membership_id=#{member} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_import_backup SET rollback_status=#{status},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{id} AND rollback_status <> 'RESTORED'

UPDATE forge_io_task SET rollback_status=CASE WHEN #{status}='UNAVAILABLE' THEN rollback_status ELSE #{status} END,rollback_attempts=rollback_attempts+1, restored_count=CASE WHEN #{status}='UNAVAILABLE' THEN restored_count ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId} AND rollback_status='RESTORED') END, skipped_count=CASE WHEN #{status}='UNAVAILABLE' THEN skipped_count ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId} AND rollback_status='SKIPPED') END, failed_count=CASE WHEN #{status}='UNAVAILABLE' THEN failed_count ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId} AND rollback_status='FAILED') END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{taskId}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT task_id FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY task_id LIMIT 100
SELECT id FROM forge_io_task WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{taskId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE forge_io_task SET rollback_status=CASE WHEN snapshot_count > 0 AND snapshot_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId} AND rollback_status='RESTORED') THEN 'SUCCEEDED' WHEN rollback_status='NONE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId} AND rollback_status <> 'PENDING') THEN 'PARTIAL' ELSE rollback_status END, restored_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId} AND rollback_status='RESTORED'), skipped_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId} AND rollback_status='SKIPPED'), failed_count=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId} AND rollback_status='FAILED'), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted AND id=#{taskId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM forge_import_backup WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId})
UPDATE forge_import_backup SET field_values=CAST('{}' AS jsonb),deleted=true,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted AND task_id=#{taskId} AND expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE forge_import_backup SET field_values=CAST('{}' AS jsonb),deleted=true,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted
UPDATE forge_io_task SET snapshot_count=0,snapshot_expires_at=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=NULL WHERE NOT deleted AND snapshot_count > 0
